InputProperty.name: Input
InputProperty.Documentation: This property specifies the input to the writer.

StringVectorProperty.name: FileName
StringVectorProperty.Documentation: The name of the file to be written.

StringVectorProperty.name: FileName
StringVectorProperty.Documentation: The H5Part (HDF5) particle file to read.

StringVectorProperty.name: StepName
StringVectorProperty.Documentation: Prefix used for each time-step group in the file (usually "Step"). Groups are named Step#0, Step#1, etc.

IntVectorProperty.name: GenerateVertexCells
IntVectorProperty.Documentation: When on (default), a vertex cell is generated for each particle so the dataset can be rendered as points. Turn off if only point coordinates and data arrays are needed.

IntVectorProperty.name: IntegerTimeStepValues
IntVectorProperty.Documentation: When on, time values are reported as 0, 1, ... N-1 regardless of the real time values stored in the file.

IntVectorProperty.name: MaskOutOfTimeRangeOutput
IntVectorProperty.Documentation: When on, a request for a time outside the file's time range returns an empty dataset instead of clamping to the nearest valid step.

IntVectorProperty.name: DisplayPartitionBoxes
IntVectorProperty.Documentation: When on, bounding boxes of each parallel partition found in the file are rendered as wireframe outlines alongside the particles.

IntVectorProperty.name: DisplayPieceBoxes
IntVectorProperty.Documentation: When on, bounding boxes of each piece assigned to this rank are rendered as wireframe outlines alongside the particles.

IntVectorProperty.name: IgnorePartitionBoxes
IntVectorProperty.Documentation: When on, partition boxes stored in the file are ignored and a simple contiguous extent split is used instead. Display of partition/piece boxes is also disabled.

IntVectorProperty.name: RandomizePartitionExtents
IntVectorProperty.Documentation: When on (testing only), partition extents are randomly perturbed so that piece boundaries do not fall on exact multiples of the partition size.

IntVectorProperty.name: CombineVectorComponents
IntVectorProperty.Documentation:
When on (default), scalar arrays whose names end with a recognised component suffix are automatically combined into a single multi-component vector field instead of being loaded as individual scalars. Recognised suffixes (case-insensitive, after an underscore) are:
_0 _1 _2 ... (numeric, component index = N) _x _y _z (Cartesian, components 1 2 3) _i _j _k (alternative Cartesian) _u _v _w (alternative Cartesian)
For example E_x, E_y, E_z are combined into a 3-component vector named "E"; FLUID_velocity_0, FLUID_velocity_1, FLUID_velocity_2 are combined into "FLUID_velocity". The original component arrays are not exported separately. When off, every array is loaded as an independent scalar.

IntVectorProperty.name: ExportVectorComponentsMagnitude
IntVectorProperty.Documentation: When on (requires CombineVectorComponents), an additional single-component array named "<vector>_magnitude" is exported for every combined multi-component vector. The magnitude is computed as sqrt(sum of squared components). Off by default.

IntVectorProperty.name: MultiComponentArraysAsFieldData
IntVectorProperty.Documentation: (Not currently implemented.) Reserved for future use.

IntVectorProperty.name: UseStridedMultiComponentRead
IntVectorProperty.Documentation: When on, use a strided HDF5 hyperslab to read an array such as "X" directly into a coordinate array. Off by default.

IntVectorProperty.name: MaxParticlesPerRank
IntVectorProperty.Documentation: Maximum number of particles to read per rank. 0 means unlimited (read the full partition). When > 0, each rank reads at most MaxParticlesPerRank particles from its partition, providing a spatially distributed sample of the full dataset for interactive exploration of very large files. Use UseStridedMaxParticlesPerRank to choose between contiguous and strided sampling.

IntVectorProperty.name: UseStridedMaxParticlesPerRank
IntVectorProperty.Documentation: When enabled (and MaxParticlesPerRank > 0), each rank reads MaxParticlesPerRank particles spread evenly across its partition instead of the first MaxParticlesPerRank contiguous particles. This samples the full spatial extent of the partition. The read is implemented with an efficient HDF5 strided hyperslab selection.

StringVectorProperty.name: Xarray
StringVectorProperty.Documentation: The array to use for the X coordinate. Auto-detected from the file with priority: bare x/X, coords_x, then Coords_0.

StringVectorProperty.name: Yarray
StringVectorProperty.Documentation: The array to use for the Y coordinate. Auto-detected from the file with priority: bare y/Y, coords_y, then Coords_1.

StringVectorProperty.name: Zarray
StringVectorProperty.Documentation: The array to use for the Z coordinate. Auto-detected from the file with priority: bare z/Z, coords_z, then Coords_2.

StringVectorProperty.name: PointArrayStatus
StringVectorProperty.label: Point Arrays
StringVectorProperty.Documentation: This property lists which point-centered arrays to read.
